profiles.title: XT30PW-M36 2-pin power inlet (LCSC C9900222726, measured on the live editor)
profiles.source: measured 2026-10-02: C9900222726 placed at (200,600) on test/P24 (probe page 2885d8c09a1a9be3); sch.component_pins answered pin 1 '+' at (180,605) and pin 2 '-' at (180,595), both PinLength 10; its own bbox was [189.5,584.5,210.5,615.5] -> body (-10.5,-15.5,10.5,15.5). Both pins leave the LEFT face, 10 units apart vertically. Evidence: outputs/089/libprobe/pins_conn.json + 07_geometry_probe.json

profiles.title: SMCJ28CA bidirectional TVS, SMC/DO-214AB (LCSC C356792, measured)
profiles.source: measured 2026-10-02: C356792 placed at (500,600) on test/P24; sch.component_pins answered pin 1 'K' at (480,600) and pin 2 'A' at (520,600), both PinLength 20; its own bbox was [489.5,594.5,510.5,605.5] -> body (-10.5,-5.5,10.5,5.5). The part is declared bidirectionally ('双向') yet its pins are still named K/A. Evidence: outputs/089/libprobe/pins_tvs.json + 07_geometry_probe.json

profiles.title: PWR-+24V
profiles.source: flag glyph convention of the compiler (the host places a power flag by kind+net, never from a library profile). Measured on the live host 2026-10-02 for the family: Power flag at (200,450) has its connection point AT the origin (PinLength 5) and its glyph 4.5..10.5 units ABOVE it (bbox [194.5,454.5,205.5,460.5]); Ground flag at (500,450) has the connection point at the origin (PinLength 10) and its bars 9.5..19.5 units BELOW it ([489.5,430.5,510.5,440.5]) — pit 43's two families, re-measured. Evidence: outputs/089/libprobe/pins_flag*.json + 07_geometry_probe.json
